definitions.gloss: inflicting harm; causing damage; doing harm
definitions.explanation: The act of causing injury, damage, or harm to another person. Used primarily in legal, news, and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{加害者|かがいしゃ}→加害者：11916_kagaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{加害|かがい}⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。

⟦いじめ→いじめ：09092_ijime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{加害|かがい}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Those on the perpetrating side of bullying often have underlying issues as well.

notes:
Composed of {加|か} (add/inflict) and ⟦{害|がい}→害：02542_gai⟧ (harm). Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{加害者|かがいしゃ}→加害者：11916_kagaisha⟧ (perpetrator/offender), which pairs with ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧ (victim). The word frames harm from the perspective of the one causing it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{加害者|かがいしゃ}→加害者：11916_kagaisha⟧: perpetrator, offender
- {加害|かがい}⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧: act of harm, harmful act
- {加害|かがい}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the perpetrating side
- {加害|かがい}⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧: responsibility for harm caused

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: damage suffered / victimization — the opposite perspective, receiving harm
- ⟦{危害|きがい}→危害：19386_kigai⟧: bodily harm / injury — focuses specifically on physical harm
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧: damage / loss — focuses on material or financial damage

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Do not confuse with ⟦{花街|かがい}→花街：17224_kagai⟧ (geisha district), which has the same reading.
